name: UpdateDispatchB_CallInputKick
description: call InputWorkerKick 5AB7B0 at the END of the logic frame (FrameTask_Update -> FrameDtSetup -> UpdateDispatchB), i.e. BEFORE the QPC limiter in FrameEnd: the pad sample used by the next frame is taken here (stock). Site K / IK (E8 DC 00 00 00)

name: FrameEarlyUpdate_CallPadStageWait
description: call InputWorkerWaitPadStage 86C018 (<=1 ms wait for the pad stage) at the START of the logic frame, before GameModeUpdateMain consumes the pad. Site C / IKc: IK moves the input kick here (E8 69 F5 2B 00)

name: FrameStepAndLimit_StoreFrameTime
description: limiter exit: mov [r15],rdx (last-frame QPC) ; xorps xmm1,xmm1 (49 89 17 0F 57 C9); TS probe L in latency_live.fsx (aka FrameEnd_LimiterExitStore)

name: RenderFrameBegin_CallQpcNow
description: render-frame begin timestamp (call QpcNow, result kept at [rsp+30h]); TS probe W (E8 57 02 D6 FF)

name: RenderFrameBegin_CallLatencyMarkersAfterWait
description: first call (6B8D34) after the frame-latency waitable wait; TS probe B. Under vkd3d-proton this point ~= the moment the previous frame was presented (waitable released after vkWaitForPresentKHR)

name: LatencyMarkerBeginFrame
description: first latency-marker call after the waitable wait in RenderFrameBegin (Streamline/Reflex/XeLL abstraction range 6B88DC..); no-op without Reflex/XeLL

name: GfxDevicePresent_SetEventPresentThread
description: SetEvent(GfxDevice+7720h): hands Present(SyncInterval=+424Ch) to the present thread; TS probe P (FF 15 F0 BD 50 03)

name: GfxFrameSlotAdvance
description: after each Present: slot +4730h = (slot+1) % BufferCount(+4240h = 3), then GfxWaitFenceValue(slot fence +4320h[slot]) = waits until the GPU finished the frame that last used this slot (frame N-2): engine frames in flight = 3; also flushes per-slot query ranges

name: GfxWaitFenceValue
signature: void (GfxDevice* d, u64 value, HANDLE ev)
description: if fence(+6D8h) < value: ID3D12Fence::SetEventOnCompletion(value, ev) + WaitForSingleObject(ev, INFINITE), or a Sleep(0) poll when ev is NULL

name: DxgiCreateSwapChain
signature: bool (GfxDevice* d, Desc* desc, Window* w, u32 refreshHz)
description: CreateDXGIFactory1 (sl.interposer) -> legacy IDXGIFactory::CreateSwapChain(queue +4270h, DXGI_SWAP_CHAIN_DESC: BufferCount = desc+8 (3), Flags = cfg+3Ch (0x842 incl. FRAME_LATENCY_WAITABLE_OBJECT)) -> QI IDXGISwapChain3 into +4278h -> MakeWindowAssociation(hwnd, 3). The game never calls SetMaximumFrameLatency (no swapchain vtbl+F8h call anywhere): waitable max latency stays at its default 1

name: FrameMgrCtor
description: FrameMgr (G, vtable 3B1F308) constructor: CreateGameWindow, CreateUpscaler, GetRenFpsCap

name: GfxDevice::BufferCount
description: swapchain BufferCount (3); also the number of engine frame slots (modulo in GfxFrameSlotAdvance)

name: GfxDevice::SyncInterval
description: Present SyncInterval = VSYNC config (0/1), written by DisplaySettingsWatcher 1350210 and the swapchain (re)create

name: GfxDevice::SlotFenceValue
description: per-slot fence value returned by GfxSubmitFrameCmdList; waited on by GfxFrameSlotAdvance before slot reuse
